rules.heading: 1.Dairy
rules.statement: Received between 2°C and 6°C. Any consignment outside that range at the point of receipt is refused entire.

rules.heading: 2.Fresh produce
rules.statement: Inspected on receipt; wastage above 5% of the consignment is raised as a return the same day.

rules.heading: 3. Recording
rules.statement: Receiving temperature is written on the delivery note and retained with the invoice.
